moment: Van der Linde gang camp by a lake at sunset (Horseshoe Overlook feel): covered wagon, tethered horses, canvas tents, campfire with hanging pot
why: Covered wagon + hitched horses + wall tents + cooking pot over fire + pine ridge over a lake is the exact RDR2 camp composition and golden-hour grade.

moment: Town notice board with wanted/bounty posters
why: Weathered plank board with nailed, foxed paper sheets in a dusty frontier street reads as a Western bounty board; RDR2 is the strongest Western reference in the set but this alone is generic Western.

moment: Harbour of tall ships at night (Port Royal / Tortuga) with a treasure-map route card
why: Moonlit harbour of square-riggers plus a dotted route ending in an X and a skull reads pirate adventure; hinged octagonal compass hints Jack Sparrow's compass. Could also be Sea of Thieves.

moment: Arthur Morgan's journal: pencil sketches of a camp layout, lake, pines and a saddled horse
why: Graphite sketch style on cream paper with taped note, horse with saddlebags and pines is the RDR2 journal look.

moment: Golden-hour vista over a river valley with a lone grazing horse (Heartlands / Great Plains)
why: Warm haze, oak silhouette, river and a lone saddled horse is classic RDR2 photo-mode landscape, though generic Western art could look like this.

moment: Floating candles under the enchanted night-sky ceiling of the Great Hall
why: Hovering lit candles against a starry sky is the signature Great Hall image; the bracket target on one candle is UI, not film.

moment: Enchanted ceiling with floating candles, quill-stroke dividers
why: Floating candles on a starfield and quill flourishes read Hogwarts; quite abstract on its own.

moment: Same golden-hour valley with grazing horse, framed as a card
why: Same plate as J005; RDR2 landscape grading.

moment: Hogwarts Express crossing the Glenfinnan Viaduct
why: Red steam locomotive and maroon carriages on the curved stone viaduct over a Highland loch is unmistakable.

moment: Wanted-poster notice board (same as J002, slightly different crop)
why: Western bounty board; Western-generic without the text.

moment: Empty engineering lecture hall with a quadcopter drawn on the blackboard (Rancho's drone)
why: Stone-and-concrete hall with a sunlit colonnade (IIM-Bangalore look where the film was shot) plus a hand-drawn quadcopter strongly suggests ICE college in 3 Idiots.

moment: The Black Pearl looming in night fog, with a treasure-map route overlay
why: Black-hulled galleon with tattered sails, lanterns and mist plus an X-marks-the-spot map.

moment: Jack Sparrow's compass over the Black Pearl at night
why: Hinged octagonal compass with a red needle over a ragged-sailed ship in fog.

moment: Virus's astronaut pen in its velvet case on a classroom desk, with a stopwatch
why: An heirloom pen presented in a box in a chalkboard classroom, next to a stopwatch (Virus times everything) maps to the space-pen handover.

moment: Astronaut pen in its case, closer crop
why: Same object set as J014.

moment: Camp at night: two tents and a campfire under dark mountains
why: Fits the RDR2 night camp mood, but alone it is just a campsite.

moment: Marauder's Map spread on a hall floor with footprints, floating candles and Hogwarts through the windows
why: Parchment with walking footprint trail, floating candles and a Gothic castle silhouette outside.

moment: Night sea with a glowing breaking wave, distant ship, Jack's compass
why: Moody night sea and a lone galleon plus the octagonal compass; the bioluminescent wave is less canonical.

moment: Hogwarts on the Black Lake at night with floating candles and a broomstick
why: Castle silhouette on the lake, broomstick and floating candles are all core HP icons.

moment: Galleon on the horizon at sunset with a glowing wake, treasure-map route card
why: Pirate route map with skull and X; ocean plate itself is generic.

moment: Enchanted ceiling, floating candles
why: Same candle-starfield motif as J006/J007.

moment: Arthur's journal sketches (lake, pines, horse) with a drawn ladder/track
why: Same journal treatment as J004.

moment: Chalkboard with a drone and a bar chart in a sunlit stone classroom
why: Drone sketch ties to the 3 Idiots set, but the Gothic arched window reads more Hogwarts classroom; mixed signal.

moment: Gang camp at dusk: lit tent, covered wagon, cooking fire, mountains over a lake
why: Same RDR2 camp vocabulary as J001.

moment: Night sea, glowing wave, distant ship, Jack's compass
why: Same as J018.

moment: Yellow scooter on the shore of Pangong Tso (the final reunion scene)
why: Yellow scooter parked on a pebbly shore of a still, high-altitude lake under bare Ladakh mountains is the film's iconic closing image.

moment: The Marauder's Map unfolded, title banner and moving footprints
why: Folded parchment with corridor outlines, ink footprints and a ribbon banner.

moment: Lecture hall blackboard with the quadcopter drawing
why: Same as J011.

moment: Stormy sea with a treasure-map route card
why: Storm sea alone is generic; map card carries the pirate read.

moment: The Black Pearl under a full moon, Jack's compass
why: Black galleon with shredded sails, glowing stern windows, moonlit fog and the hinged compass.

moment: The Great Hall with house tables and floating candles
why: Four long tables, high table under a Gothic window, hundreds of floating candles.

moment: Dead Eye: red-tinted homestead with X target marks along a path
why: Red/sepia wash plus X markers painted onto targets is the Dead Eye mechanic.

moment: The Black Pearl at night with a dotted route ending at an X
why: Same ship as J030 with a treasure trail.

moment: Marauder's Map corridors with footprints walking
why: Footprints moving along drawn corridors on folded parchment.

moment: Dead Eye marking crows over a red-tinted homestead
why: Red Dead Eye wash with X marks painted onto birds in the sky.

moment: Rancho's homemade drone flying in the college courtyard
why: DIY quadcopter hovering in a stone/concrete campus with pergolas; matches the drone scene and the IIM-B location.

moment: Homemade drone hovering by a colonnade on campus
why: Same as J036.

moment: The Great Hall, floating candles
why: Same as J031.

moment: Yellow scooter at Pangong Lake, circled and ticked
why: Same iconic final-scene image as J026.
